parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` and reside under `Shared/Playlist/Tests/PlaylistTests/`. The two methods — `PlaylistServiceCachingTests.loadsCachedPlaylistOnInit` and `PlaylistServiceTests.observerReceivesCachedDataDuringCacheLoad` — have structurally similar bodies (Jaccard 0.7) but test distinct observable behaviours: one verifies that a cached playlist is loaded on initialisation, the other verifies that an observer receives cached data during an in-progress cache load. Despite the shape overlap, collapsing them would obscure the separate failure signals each test is designed to surface, which is the primary value of keeping them distinct.
